title: Not working for me
text: Not working for me. I'm not really a fan, the macaroons stuck to the mat and destroyed half of them, so that was no help at all and the squeeze thing is better used for decorating with whipped cream. It was working for the first couple, but halfway through, it got really hard to squeeze it out. Unfortunately, money wasted for me, I should have stuck with old school parchment paper and a decorating bag.
